items.title: Meta Ads: $97.01 spend, 3 leads, $32.34 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: The most recent prior meta-ads.json (2026-08-31) covered spend through 2026-08-30, so this run widened from the standard --days 1 to --days 2 (2026-08-31 through 2026-09-01) to close the gap. Over that window Meta spent $97.01, all on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 3 leads at $32.34 CPL. CPL is up from the 7-day baseline (2026-08-26 to 2026-09-01: $349.50 / 17 leads, ~$20.56 CPL) but at ~1.6x, below the 2x anomaly threshold; account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Window widened: the most recent prior meta-ads.json was 2026-08-31, covering spend through 2026-08-30. Per policy this run widened from the standard yesterday-only pull to 2 days (2026-08-31 through 2026-09-01) to cover the gap, rather than missing 2026-08-31 entirely.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 3 in this window, 17 in the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times, same as flagged on 2026-08-31). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this recurrence suggests the script's lead-action set should be reviewed for extension rather than continuing to hand-note it each run.
